status_definitions.READY: The current candidate reports the required content with an adequate manuscript location and any required supporting artifact exists.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Some prose or evidence exists, but at least one required element, final pointer, or journal facing artifact is missing.
status_definitions.OPEN: The core requirement is absent from the current candidate or a mandatory deliverable has not been produced.
status_definitions.JUSTIFIED_NA: The review design makes the item inapplicable and the nonperformance and reason are explicitly reported.

axis_definitions.reported_in_prose: Whether the requirement is actually stated in the v2 manuscript prose.
axis_definitions.materialized_artifact: Whether a real supporting file exists. A blueprint or future production comment is not an artifact.
axis_definitions.final_manuscript_pointer: Whether the candidate points readers to the final figure, table, supplement, protocol, or repository location.
axis_definitions.public_availability_release: Whether the cited material is publicly deposited and released. Draft staging is not release.
